name: Heart of Hearts
source:
Magic has given a great boost to growth of "Shinsen" country, however it also triggered mass production of monsters that conquered this land. As time passed, an expedition was organized to recapture the territory with the use of soldier raising skills.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
魔法极大地推动了"神仙"国的发展，却也导致怪物被大量制造，最终占领了这片土地。随着时间流逝，人们组织起一支远征队，试图借助培养士兵的技术夺回失地。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-march-2001.html]vndbreview[/url]]
